author: Professor_Jonble
body: Sorry I don't know where to post this, but I just got tempbanned for "exploiting glitches" when I don't know what I did? Can the person who banned me answer this please?
body_tagged: Sorry I don't know where to post this, but I just got tempbanned for "exploiting glitches" when I don't know what I did? Can the person who banned me answer this please?
title: Help?

replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body: You shot a player over the walls before they dropped. This is illegal, you were punished accordingly.
replies.body_tagged: You shot a player over the walls before they dropped. This is illegal, you were punished accordingly.

replies.author: Professor_Jonble
replies.body: I was shooting back in self defense -.-
replies.body_tagged: I was shooting back in self defense -.-

replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body: I am sorry that that was the case, but you retaliated with an illegal action. I am aware that the player who was shooting you was also breaking the rules, but next time report them and do not shoot back.
